artifacts.summary: Verifies the lem:nullity strengthening and finds the live paper has drifted on 26 of 43 pinned anchors, not one, making the stated acceptance criterion unreachable under the stated scope; inventories every in-tree site, confirms no Lean work is needed, and names C35 citation-manifest regeneration as an unlisted gate obligation.

user_decision.question: check-paper-definitions.sh now reports 26 drifted anchors against the live paper, not the one (lem:nullity) the task description assumes, so the acceptance criterion 'exits 0 against the live paper' cannot be met by re-pinning lem:nullity alone. Absorb all 26 as one dated drift-correction re-pin (recommended: 20 of the extra 25 are presentational, 5 content-bearing, none contradicting the formalization), or re-pin lem:nullity only and amend the acceptance criterion plus spawn a follow-on for the other 25?
user_decision.recommendation: Absorb all 26 in one dated re-pin, following the record file's own 10-anchor and 14-anchor precedents. Option B leaves the local gate red, which is the condition the task exists to clear, and means reading the same paper twice.
options: Option A (recommended): absorb all 26 drifted anchors as one dated 2026-10-14 drift-correction re-pin, with the in-tree verbatim judgment pass scoped to those anchors
